title: The Dominance Stare: Psychological Power Play

vo.en: Stare at their forehead to win.

visual.description: An intense extreme close-up of a man's brow and eyes with a sharp, focused expression.

vo.en: Normal eye contact creates a social bond, making you both feel like equals.

visual.description: Two men in business attire shaking hands and talking in a brightly lit modern office.

vo.en: But to project absolute dominance, move your gaze to the center of their forehead.

visual.description: A digital target or bullseye graphic overlaying a macro shot of a human forehead.

vo.en: But here is the creepy part.

visual.description: A dark, moody shot of an hourglass with sand falling quickly against a black background.

vo.en: This stare triggers their primitive brain, signaling that you are judging their every move.

visual.description: A wild panther moving slowly through dark grass, focusing its eyes forward.

vo.en: They will start stuttering or looking down because you’ve stolen their psychological comfort.

visual.description: A man in a suit looking visibly uncomfortable, adjusting his tie and shifting his eyes away.

vo.en: This one micro-movement shifts the power dynamic instantly into your hands.

visual.description: A hand moving a black king chess piece forward on a board to topple the white king.

vo.en: Subscribe for tomorrow's brain hack and comment POWER if this worked, all because you...

visual.description: A close-up of a thumb pressing a glowing digital button on a smartphone screen.
